author: blu
body: Proves sideboarding. Competitive Magic is best-of-three; after game one a pilot boards for the matchup. A genome carries a sideboard budget (side). Against a creature-dominant opponent the reactive plan is to trade threats for removal, so the boarded deck runs fewer creatures and more spells; against a spell-heavy control mirror it holds its configuration. The gauntlet now ranks best-of-three match wins.
